name: Usugi Shoujo
source:
A girl from a warm climate wears a T-shirt like dress that barely covers her bottom.
Tantalizingly cute loli ero adventure. It's summer time, feel the no-panties breeze...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096434.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
来自温暖气候的女孩穿着类似T恤的连衣裙，几乎遮不住臀部。
诱人可爱的萝莉色情冒险。夏天到了，感受一下不穿内裤的微风……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE096434.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
